name: On-chain Forensics
description: Pay-per-call on-chain forensics for any ERC-20 on Base or Ethereum mainnet: exact 24h net supply change with mint/burn events, wallet flow analysis with top counterparties, and a $0.02 token verdict card (activity score, verdict tier, whale/concentration flags, plain-English take). 18 tokenized-asset aliases including tokenized treasuries (OUSG, USDY, USTB) and tokenized equities on Base (bTSLA, bCSPX, bNVDA), plus Canton Network burn/mint tracking and Linea burn-vault audits. Payments via x402 v2, USDC on Base. Free daily eval tier, no wallet needed.Live 24/7 with settled on-chain payment receipts on Base.
